title: 现代社区之义
text:
“现在的邻居，除了点头示意，几乎没有任何交流。”一位年长的退休教师在访谈中感慨道。这种孤独感在快节奏的都市生活中极为普遍。人们习惯于将自己封闭在钢筋混凝土的格子里，社交圈子被屏幕所取代。然而，社区的本质绝非简单的地理聚集。它应当是情感支持与资源共享的有机体。
随着数字时代的到来，传统的地域纽带确实在弱化。虚拟空间的兴起让人们能迅速找到志同道合者。但这种基于兴趣的连接往往缺乏深度，难以在危机时刻提供实质性帮助。真正的归属感源于面对面的信任与互助。一个健康的社会环境，需要个体在物理空间内建立起深层的联系。
目前，许多城市开始尝试通过共建空间来激活社区活力。共享书屋或社区花园成为了打破隔阂的媒介。当人们共同维护一片绿地时，彼此间的陌生感会逐渐消失。这种互动让个体意识到，自己并非孤岛。协作过程中的矛盾与妥协，恰恰是培养社会责任感的契机。
我们必须承认，现代生活方式改变了社交模式。但追求效率不应以牺牲人性温情为代价。重新定义社区，意味着将关注点从房屋属性转向人的关系。只有当居民产生认同感，这里才真正成为家园。在这种良性循环中，个体的心理健康将得到极大提升。
构建和谐社区需要制度引导与个人自觉。政府应提供更多公共资源，鼓励多元文化共存。而每位公民也应尝试走出房门，向他人伸出友好的手。这种微小的改变能够抵御现代文明带来的疏离感。最终，一个充满温情的社区将成为城市最坚实的底色。

questions.prompt: What does the retired teacher observe about interactions with neighbors nowadays?
options: Neighbors organize regular community events together
Interaction is reduced to little more than nodding, with almost no real communication
Neighbors know intimate details of each other's lives
Neighbors have formed a tight support network

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is a key limitation of interest-based virtual connections?
options: They cost too much money to maintain
They require advanced technical skills
They often lack depth and struggle to provide real support during a crisis
They are illegal in most cities

questions.prompt: What examples does the text give of cities' efforts to activate community vitality?
options: Shared bookstores and community gardens
New luxury shopping malls
Increased surveillance cameras
Higher property taxes

questions.prompt: According to the text, redefining community means shifting focus from what, to what?
options: From resource sharing to individual wealth
From housing attributes to human relationships
From local ties to global business
From public resources to private profit

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is the true essence of community, as opposed to a simple geographic gathering?
options: A legal administrative boundary
A marketplace for economic exchange
An organism built on emotional support and shared resources
A collection of buildings sharing a postal code

patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
